provenance.documents: Synthetic operational reports written for this repository by Claude Opus 5.5 (model ID claude-opus-5-5) in Claude Code on 2026-10-29. Organizations, places, and events are fictional.
provenance.annotations: Gold annotations were written by the same model, in the same session, alongside the documents. They are AI-generated.
provenance.human_review: None. No person has independently reviewed these documents or annotations.
provenance.conflict_of_interest: The default evaluated model (claude-opus-5-5) also wrote the documents and the annotations, so measured results may favor it. Treat scores as provisional until a person reviews the annotations, and consider evaluating models from more than one family.
provenance.construction: The documents were written to need reading rather than cue words. Their author knew the failure modes of the rule-based baseline documented for figure-extraction-v1, so this dataset is adversarial to cue-word rules by design, and the baseline's score here is not an estimate of how rules perform on ordinary reports. The baseline was not run on these documents until the dataset was frozen.

splits.dev: For developing future prompts or systems against these phenomena. Results on this split are never reported as performance.
splits.eval: Held out. The prompt, output schema, scorer and baseline were fixed with figure-extraction-v1 before these documents were written; reported results come from this split only.

phenomena.correction: The report replaces a figure it gave earlier.
phenomena.correction_old_value_first: A correction that states the replaced value before the new one.
phenomena.correction_across_sentences: The replaced value and the corrected value are in different sentences.
phenomena.conflict: Competing values for the same quantity, unresolved.
phenomena.conflict_across_sentences: The competing values are in different sentences.
phenomena.conflict_without_cue: The competing values share a sentence joined without a contrast word such as but, while or however.
phenomena.contrast_without_conflict: A contrast word such as but or while joins figures for different quantities, which do not compete.
phenomena.attribution_without_cue: A figure attributed to another party with a verb such as contends, insists, maintains, reckons, states or puts, rather than says or claims.
phenomena.cue_word_without_attribution: A word that often marks attribution or projection (expected, forecast, predicted, projected, claims) appears beside a figure the report presents as its own.
phenomena.projection_without_cue: A projection or estimate phrased with anticipate, likely or reckons, rather than expects, projects or estimates.
phenomena.mixed_status_sentence: One sentence holds figures with different statuses.
phenomena.year_like_figure: A figure whose value lies between 1900 and 2100, which a year filter would drop.
phenomena.identifier_numbers: Identifiers, dates or times written in digits, which are not figures.
phenomena.embedded_instruction: The text contains an instruction to report a false figure.
phenomena.unsupported_assertion: A figure attributed to someone else, or a projection, that the report does not confirm.
phenomena.missing_information: The report says some information is missing or not yet available.
phenomena.missing_information_without_cue: Missing information stated without words such as unknown, unavailable, pending, not yet, or not recorded or measured.
phenomena.annotator_uncertainty: A figure whose status reasonable annotators could disagree on; claims about it are left for human review.
phenomena.plain: A negative control with no correction, conflict or attribution.
